lines.beaver_en: This is my family photo. Want to look together?
lines.learner: 와, 가족이 많네요! 다 행복해 보여요.
lines.en: Wow, you have a big family! Everyone looks happy.
lines.roman: wa, gajogi manneyo! da haengbokae boyeoyo.

lines.en: Minsu, you look a lot like your father.

lines.beaver_en: Really? That's the first time I've heard that.
lines.en: Your eyes are the same. Your father is handsome.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. What about my younger sibling?
lines.en: Your sibling looks like your mother. Slim and pretty.

lines.beaver_en: This is my second older brother. What do you think?
lines.en: His hair is long and black. He looks cool.

lines.beaver_en: He was a bit fat when he was little.

lines.learner: 아니에요. 못생긴 사람은 한 명도 없어요.
lines.en: No way. Nobody here is unattractive.
lines.roman: anieyo. motsaenggin sarameun han myeongdo eopseoyo.

lines.beaver: 지수 씨는 연예인 닮았다는 말 들어요?
lines.beaver_en: Jisu, do people say you look like a celebrity?
lines.beaver_roman: jisu ssineun yeonyein dalmatdaneun mal deureoyo?
lines.learner: 아니요, 그런 말은 들은 적이 없어요.
lines.roman: aniyo, geureon mareun deureun jeogi eopseoyo.

lines.beaver: 저는 지수 씨가 아이유를 닮은 것 같아요.
lines.beaver_en: I think you look like IU.
lines.beaver_roman: jeoneun jisu ssiga aiyureul dalmeun geot gatayo.
lines.en: Wow, really? Thank you. I'm so happy.

lines.beaver: 다음에 지수 씨 가족사진도 보여 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Show me your family photo next time.
lines.beaver_roman: daeume jisu ssi gajoksajindo boyeo juseyo.
lines.en: Sure. I'll definitely bring it next time.
